19000.meaning1: (of a suspended monk) reinstatement; readmission (into the community)
19000.meaning2: bringing before the Saṅgha, admitting; especially re-admitting (a suspended monk) to the Saṅgha; re-accepting (a layman, who had been disciplined)

examples.text: vakkhati ca, atthi bhikkhave puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañ'ce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco suosārito, ekacco duosārito'ti tass'attho āgataṭṭhāne'y'eva āvi bhavissatī'ti.

19001.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from osāreti, caus
19001.meaning1: (of a suspended monk) reinstatement; readmission (into the community)

examples.text: dve'mā, bhikkhave, osāraṇā. atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ tañ'ce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco sosārito, ekacco dosārito.

19003.meaningLit: to be caused to flow down
19003.commentary: (VINa) parivāsadān'ādīsu osāraṇīyaṃ paññattan'ti aṭṭhārasasu vā tecattālīsāya vā vattesu vattamānassa osāraṇīyaṃ paññattaṃ. yena kammena osārīyati, taṃ kammaṃ paññattan'ti attho. (PYt) vattesu vattamāno puggalo osārīyati anenā'ti osāraṇīyaṃ, kammaṃ. tena vuttaṃ yena kammena osārīyati, taṃ kammaṃ paññattan'ti.

examples.text: dve atthavase paṭicca tathāgatena sāvakānaṃ pātimokkhaṃ paññattaṃ … abbhānaṃ paññattaṃ… osāraṇīyaṃ paññattaṃ… nissāraṇīyaṃ paññattaṃ… upasampadaṃ paññattaṃ… apalokanakammaṃ paññattaṃ… ñattikammaṃ paññattaṃ… ñattidutiyakammaṃ paññattaṃ… ñatticatutthakammaṃ paññattaṃ ….

19004.meaning2: makes enter; puts into or on to; lowers (into)

19005.meaning2: makes re-enter, re-admits (a monk to the Saṅgha after suspension)

examples.text: akaṭ'ānudhammo nāma ukkhitto anosārito.

19012.meaning1: should be reinstated; should be readmitted
19012.meaningLit: to cause to be flowed down
19012.commentary: (VMVt) osāretabbo'ti iminā purimo ukkhittabhāvo vibbhamitvā puna laddh'ūpasampadam'pi na muñcati. tena ca sambhuñjan'ādīsu'pi bhikkhūnaṃ pācittiyam'evā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: abbhetabbo'ti abhietabbo sampaṭicchitabbo, abbhānakammavasena osāretabbo'ti vuttaṃ hoti, avhātabbo'ti vā attho.

19013.meaning1: should be checked; should be gone into (in); should be cross-referenced
19013.meaningLit: to cause to be flowed down
19013.commentary: (DNa) sutte osāretabbānī'ti sutte otāretabbāni. vinaye sandassetabbānī'ti vinaye saṃsandetabbāni.

examples.text: tassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padabyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte osāretabbāni, vinaye sandassetabbāni.

19014.meaning1: (of a suspended monastic) reinstates; readmits (into the community)

examples.text: vakkhati ca, atthi bhikkhave puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañ'ce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco suosārito, ekacco duosārito'ti tass'attho āgataṭṭhāne'y'eva āvi bhavissatī'ti.
te tattha usūhi'pi vijjhanti, sattiyā'pi vijjhanti, chakaṇakāya'pi osiñcanti, abhivaggena'pi omaddanti, asinā'pi sīsaṃ chindanti. te tattha maraṇam'pi nigacchanti, maraṇamattam'pi dukkhaṃ.

19019.meaning1: pouring down; pouring over; sprinkling (something with)

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno udakena aṅgajātaṃ osiñcantassa asuci mucci.
sace udakappaṭiggāhako hoti, nīcaṃ katvā udakappaṭiggahe udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ, mā udakappaṭiggāhako udakena osiñci, mā sāmantā bhikkhū udakena osiñciṃsu, mā saṅghāṭi udakena osiñcī'ti.
tato upaḍḍhapulinaṃ, vippasannena cetasā, divāvihāre osiñciṃ, dvipad'indassa tādino.

19021.meaning1: having poured out; having bailed out
19021.commentary: (NIDD1a) udakaṃ sitvā'ti udakaṃ siñcitvā. osiñcitvā'ti atirekaṃ siñcitvā. chaḍḍetvā'ti pātetvā.

examples.text: nāvaṃ sitvā'va pāragū'ti. yathā garukaṃ nāvaṃ bhārikaṃ udakaṃ sitvā osiñcitvā chaḍḍetvā lahukāya nāvāya khippaṃ lahuṃ appakasiren'eva pāraṃ gaccheyya
kā sukkadāṭhā paṭimukkakuṇḍalā, citt'aṅgadā kambuvimaṭṭhadhārinī, osittavaṇṇaṃ paridayha sobhasi, kusaggirattaṃ apiḷayha mañjariṃ.
tam'enaṃ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya, osīda, bho sappitela, saṃsīda, bho sappitela, adho gaccha, bho sappitelā'ti.

19029.meaning2: caused to immersed, caused to sink

19030.meaning2: causes to immerse, causes to sink

19031.meaning2: having caused to immerged, having caused to sink

19032.meaning2: caused to immersed, caused to sink

19035.meaning2: having immersed, having caused to sink

examples.text: soto udañ'jalaṃ dhāvaṃ, pupphāvaliyaṃ pokkharaṃ, vālikā kaddam'oseko, sayan'aṅguṭṭhakena cā'ti.

19038.commentary: (SNa) kumārakā dhaṅkam'iv'ossajantī'ti yathā kumārakā kākaṃ gahetvā ossajanti khipanti, evaṃ pāpavitakkā kuto samuṭṭhāya cittaṃ ossajantī'ti pucchati?

examples.text: rāgo ca doso ca kutonidānā, aratī ratī lomahaṃso kutojā, kuto samuṭṭhāya manovitakkā, kumārakā dhaṅkam'iv'ossajantī'ti.

19040.commentary: (DNa) sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajī'ti satiṃ sūpaṭṭhitaṃ katvā ñāṇena paricchinditvā āyusaṅkhāraṃ vissajji, pajahi. tattha na bhagavā hatthena leḍḍuṃ viya āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji, temāsamattam'eva pana samāpattiṃ samāpajjitvā tato paraṃ na samāpajjissāmī'ti cittaṃ uppādesi. taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, ossajī'ti. ussajjī'ti pi pāṭho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji. ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā majjhe gaṇṭhiṃ karitvā ossajjeyya. atha kho, te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ

19043.commentary: (DNt) āyusaṅkhārossajjanampi ettakaṃ kālaṃ tiṭṭhāmī'ti pavattiyā bahujanahitāya paṭipatti. anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbānavasena bahujanahitāya paṭipatti.

examples.text: tattha aṭṭhahi kāraṇehi pathavīkampo veditabbo, dhāt'ukkhobhena, iddhimato ānubhāvena, bodhisattassa gabbh'okkantiyā, mātukucchito nikkhamanena, sambodhippattiyā, dhammacakkappavattanena, āyusaṅkhār'ossajjanena, parinibbānenā'ti.

atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo rañño māgadhassa ajātasattuno vedehiputtassa sabbaṃ hatthikāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ assakāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ rathakāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ pattikāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā jīvantam'eva naṃ ossajji.

19046.synonym: catta, jahita, nissajjita, nissaṭṭha, paṭinissaṭṭha, pariccatta, pahita, pahīna, vijahita, vitiṇṇa, vidhuta, vippahīna, visajjita, vissajjita, vossaṭṭha
19046.commentary: (DNa) ossaṭṭho'ti vissajjito paricchinno, evaṃ kira vatvā, ten'āyaṃ dasasahassī lokadhātu kampitthā'ti āha.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji. ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.

19047.meaning2: with one's form abandoned, abandoning one's body

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭena'pi vidhūpanena'pi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossavane'pi tiṇāni na icchanti.
ajja't'agge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo'ti.

19053.meaning2: rained upon; exposed to the rain

19054.meaning2: valuable kept in the waist pouch

19055.meaning2: waist-band, pouch (formed by twisting hem of waist-cloth)
19055.notes: When using a piece of cloth as a lower garment, the top is folded or rolled down, forming a circular pouch around the waist.

19056.meaning1: roll of an undergarment around the waist
19056.meaning2: what is rolled up or round; fold, tuck; hem; seam; girdle, waist cloth, fold of material at the waist (in which objects were carried); perhaps also a bracelet
19056.commentary: (DNt) ovaṭṭikāyā'ti parivaṭṭulavasena, guḷikāvasena sā piṇḍi kātuṃ sakkā'ti attho.
19056.notes: When using a piece of cloth as a lower garment, the top is folded or rolled down, forming a circular pouch around the waist. This is still part of traditional monastic dress to this day.

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, ghaṭikāro kumbhakāro jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ ovaṭṭikāyaṃ parāmasitvā etadavoca, ayaṃ, samma jotipāla, kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa avidūre ārāmo.
na cīvaravicāraṇamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na chedanamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na bandhanamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na ovaṭṭiyakaraṇamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ
adaḍḍhā'pi vuccati jātā pathavī. yo'pi paṃsupuñjo vā mattikāpuñjo vā atirekacātumāsaṃ ovaṭṭho, ayam'pi vuccati jātā pathavī.

19059.commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.2) ovadeyyā'ti aṭṭhahi vā garudhammehi aññena vā dhammena ovadati

examples.text: sammato'pi ce bhikkhu atthaṅ'gate sūriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ imāhi gāthāhi abhiṇhaṃ ovadatī'ti
giriduggacaraṃ chetaṃ, appapaññaṃ acetasaṃ, akāle ovadaṃ bhikkhu, mando'va paṭibhāti maṃ.
atha kho āyasmā rāhulo, ko n'ajja bhagavatā sammukhā ovādena ovadito gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisissatī'ti tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi

19065.meaning1: should be advised; should be instructed

examples.text: tassa evaṃ hoti, mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāma'pi anusāsāma'pi. ime pan'amhākaṃ puttamattā maññe nattamattā maññe ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.

19066.meaning1: to advise; to instruct; to admonish

examples.text: sabbeh'eva, bhante, kato pariyāyo bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ pariyāyena. ayaṃ, bhante, āyasmā nandako na icchati bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ pariyāyenā'ti.
akilāsuno ca te bhagavanto ahesuṃ sāvake cetasā ceto paricca ovadituṃ.

19067.meaning1: having advised; having instructed; having taught

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmantaṃ channaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu. atha kho āyasmā channo acirapakkantesu tesu āyasmantesu satthaṃ āharesi.
atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā

19069.meaning1: being advised; being instructed; being admonished (by)

examples.text: te ca navā bhikkhū therehi bhikkhūhi ovadiyamānā anusāsiyamānā uḷāraṃ pubben'āparaṃ visesaṃ jānanti.

atha kho, bhikkhave, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā attanā jātidhammā samānā jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu

19070.meaning1: being advised; being instructed; being admonished (by)

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvakā bhotā gotamena evaṃ ovadīyamānā evaṃ anusāsīyamānā sabbe accantaṃ niṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti udāhu ekacce n'ārādhentī'ti?
app'ekacce kho, brāhmaṇa, mama sāvakā mayā evaṃ ovadīyamānā evaṃ anusāsīyamānā accantaṃ niṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti, ekacce n'ārādhentī'ti.

19072.commentary: (VINa) ovaddheyyakaraṇamattenā'ti āgantukapatt'āropanamattena. kathinacīvarato vā pattaṃ gahetvā aññasmiṃ akathinacīvare patt'āropanamattena.

examples.text: na daḷhīkammakaraṇamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na anuvātakaraṇamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na paribhaṇḍakaraṇamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na ovaddheyyakaraṇamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ, na kambalamaddanamattena atthataṃ hoti kathinaṃ

19073.meaning1: having expelled; having ejected; having vomited; having thrown up
19073.meaning2: having vomited, having ejected, having discharged
19073.commentary: (UDa) mukhato ovamitvā'ti sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇ'ādiṃ mukhena chaḍḍetvā.

examples.text: atha kho so udapāno āyasmante ānande upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañ'ca bhusañ'ca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandanto maññe aṭṭhāsi.
addasaṃsu kho sakkassa devānam'indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.
yasmiṃ ovarake cīvaraṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti tasmiṃ ovarake vatthabbaṃ, hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabbaṃ.

19075.commentary: (DNa) ovaraṇaṃ ṭhapetvā'ti catūsu disāsu ārakkhake ṭhapetvā. (DNt) ovaraṇaṃ ṭhapetvā'ti paṭipakkha-nisedhana-samatthaṃ āvaraṇaṃ ṭhapetvā.

examples.text: atha kho cattāro mahārājā mahatiyā ca yakkhasenāya mahatiyā ca gandhabbasenāya mahatiyā ca kumbhaṇḍasenāya mahatiyā ca nāgasenāya catuddisaṃ rakkhaṃ ṭhapetvā catuddisaṃ gumbaṃ ṭhapetvā catuddisaṃ ovaraṇaṃ ṭhapetvā
kiṃ te aparādhitaṃ mayā, yaṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi, na hi pabbajitāya āvuso, puriso samphusanāya kappati.

19082.meaning1: rains down (onto); pours down (on); wets; drenches

examples.text: kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho, navena toyena sacīvaraṃ vane, isippayātamhi pathe vajantaṃ, ovassate taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

19083.meaning1: bathes in rain; showers; bathes by letting rain fall (on one's body)
19083.meaning2: causes to make wet through rain
19083.commentary: (VINa) naggo kāyaṃ ovassāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti ettha udakaphusitagaṇanāya akatvā nhānapariyosānavasena payoge payoge dukkaṭena kāretabbo. so ca kho vivaṭ'aṅgaṇe ākāsato patita-udaken'eva nhāyanto. nhānakoṭṭhakavāpi-ādīsu ghaṭehi āsitta-udakena vā nhāyantassa anāpatti. (VVt) ovassāpetī'ti ākāsato patita-udaken'eva kāyaṃ temeti, iminā ghaṭ'ādīhi osiñcituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti dīpitaṃ hoti. nibbakos'ambunā nahāyituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti gaṇṭhipadesu vuttaṃ.

examples.text: satiyā vassikasāṭikāya naggo kāyaṃ ovassāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ūnakamāse sese gimhāne atirekasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

19084.meaning2: caused to make wet through rain

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññāya dhammaṃ desayato no anabhiññāya, sanidānaṃ dhammaṃ desayato no anidānaṃ, sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desayato no appāṭihāriyaṃ, karaṇīyo ovādo, karaṇīyā anusāsanī.
atha kho āyasmā rāhulo, ko n'ajja bhagavatā sammukhā ovādena ovadito gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisissatī'ti tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi

evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacārino anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā. idañ'ca pana me āyasmato sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttan'ti.
evaṃ vadeyyā'ti upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ bhikkhun'ovādakaṃ avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo ayasaṃ kattu'kāmo maṅkukattu'kāmo evaṃ vadeti

19089.meaning1: who advises; who teaches; who instructs; who encourages
19089.commentary: (SNa) na santi bhikkhū ovādakā'ti imassa puggalassa ovādakā anusāsakā kalyāṇamittā n'atthī'ti idaṃ, bhante, parihānanti dasseti.

examples.text: kusīto purisapuggalo'ti, bhante, parihānam'etaṃ, duppañño purisapuggalo'ti, bhante, parihānam'etaṃ, kodhano purisapuggalo'ti, bhante, parihānam'etaṃ, upanāhī purisapuggalo'ti, bhante, parihānam'etaṃ, na santi bhikkhū ovādakā'ti, bhante, parihānam'etaṃ.
tass'ovādakarā bahugihī ca pabbajitā ca, asuciṃ garahitaṃ dhunanti pāpaṃ, sa hi sucibhi parivuto bhavati, mala-khila-kali-kilese panudehī'ti.
ovādakārī bhataposī, kulavaṃsaṃ ahāpayaṃ, saddho sīlena sampanno, putto hoti pasaṃsiyo'ti.

19093.meaning2: from whom instruction has been withdrawn

19095.meaning1: following orders; acting according to instructions; acting according to advice
19095.meaning2: acting according to orders; following instructions
19095.commentary: (ANa) ovādapaṭikarāyā'ti idaṃ vo kattabba, idaṃ na kattabban'ti dinna-ovādakarāya.

examples.text: balavā caturaṅginiyā senāya samannāgato assavāya ovādapaṭikarāya sahati maññe paccatthike yasasā

19096.meaning1: acting according to advice; following admonition; complying with instruction

examples.text: kittāvatā ca nu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvako sāsanakaro hoti ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane viharatī'ti?

19097.meaning1: Pātimokkha in the form of instruction

19098.meaning1: following orders; acting according to instructions; acting according to advice
19098.commentary: (ANa) ovādapaṭikarāyā'ti idaṃ vo kattabba, idaṃ na kattabban'ti dinnaovādakarāya.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ! abbhutaṃ, bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ! satthu ca nāma sāsanakarā bhavissanti ovādappaṭikarā, catunnañ'ca parisānaṃ piyā bhavissanti manāpā garubhāvanīyā ca!
